theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_scsp_cc_plane_orthonormal
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (u : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → u ∈ Q → ‖u‖ = 1 → ∃ e : Euclid P, e ∈ Q ∧ ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ u e = 0 ∧ ∀ v ∈ Q, v = inner ℝ v u • u + inner ℝ v e • e
